title: Chehalem Winery

services.name: Tasting Experiences
services.desc: Explore the wines and distinct terroir of Chehalem’s four estate vineyards through a guided five-wine tasting of our current releases. This flight changes monthly, providing an excellent opportunity to relax with friends and deepen your wine knowledge. Take in the vineyard views while enjoying wine by the glass or a bottle. Our Pinot Patio will be serving a special grilled menu all summer long, best enjoyed with your favorite wines. A limited number of picnic tables are available to reserve, while Adirondack chairs are offered on a first come, first serve basis. We recommend bringing a hat and sunglasses, as shade is limited. services.name: Private Events
services.desc: The Chehalem Estate Tasting Room is the perfect choice for casual gatherings, receptions, conferences, or seated dinners. We offer unique spaces all equipped with amenities and vineyard views sure to make your event unforgettable. Our team is here to help you tailor your next event to fit the needs of your occasion! Outside alcohol is not allowed. We provide all beverage service in house. We can offer beer and hard cider in addition to wine. Outside catering is not allowed.
